notes: Room and PostgreSQL column sets match the doc exactly (inventory room_columns/pg_columns: no missing or unplanned; ORM equals migration). The drift is in behavior. (1) Triage area: MainActivity saves triage_action as UI enum names (BLOOD_TEST, NO_FURTHER_ACTION, CANNOT_SCREEN), not the documented codes, and S19 hard-codes the result (8.2-10.1, threshold 12.0); the flow is hidden in v1.0 (triageEnabled false). (2) Research R03 records age_hours as a fixed 48 h default with a no-op edit, a silent default on a clinical input. (3) Retention jobs are coded but never scheduled or run at app start; research purge is wired to a NoOp hook. (4) Backend roles: no migration applies the GRANT DELETE / REVOKE UPDATE that the bootstrap promises, so audit_log is not append-only for neogold_app and app-side deletes would fail. Idempotency and auth_nonce purge jobs and the backstop scheduler are absent. (5) Device never inserts card_batch or device_profile rows, yet sessions set FK card_batch_id (hard-coded 'NG-2026-001' in screening) with foreign_keys ON.
